list.name: seller_id
list.query: SELECT shop_name AS __text, id AS __value FROM seller_profiles ORDER BY shop_name
list.label: Магазин

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(total), 0) AS value FROM orders WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled')
SELECT COALESCE(sum(total), 0) AS value FROM orders WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled') AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
SELECT COALESCE(round((sum(total) * 0.95)::numeric, 2), 0) AS value FROM orders WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled')
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id})
SELECT COALESCE(round(avg(total)::numeric, 2), 0) AS value FROM orders WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled')
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM products WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(status::text) = 'active'
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(status::text) = 'assembling'
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(status::text) = 'shipped'
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(status::text) = 'delivered'
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(status::text) = 'cancelled'
SELECT COALESCE(round(avg(r.rating)::numeric, 2), 0) AS value FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE p.seller_id IN (${seller_id})
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE p.seller_id IN (${seller_id})

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS "time", round(sum(total)::numeric, 2) AS "Оборот" FROM orders WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS "time", round((sum(total) * 0.95)::numeric, 2) AS "Выручка" FROM orders WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS "time", count(*) AS "Заказов" FROM orders WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS "time", round(avg(total)::numeric, 2) AS "AOV" FROM orders WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE lower(status::text) WHEN 'created' THEN 'Создан' WHEN 'paid' THEN 'Оплачен' WHEN 'assembling' THEN 'Сборка' WHEN 'shipped' THEN 'Отправлен' WHEN 'delivered' THEN 'Доставлен' WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 'Отменён' WHEN 'returned' THEN 'Возврат' ELSE status::text END AS "Статус", count(*) AS "Количество" FROM orders WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT CASE lower(status::text) WHEN 'draft' THEN 'Черновик' WHEN 'pending' THEN 'На модерации' WHEN 'active' THEN 'Активен' WHEN 'rejected' THEN 'Отклонён' WHEN 'archived' THEN 'Архив' ELSE status::text END AS "Статус", count(*) AS "Количество" FROM products WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) GROUP BY 1

SELECT oi.title AS "Товар", sum(oi.quantity) AS "Продано" FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(o.status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled') GROUP BY oi.title ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.name AS "Категория", sum(oi.quantity) AS "Продано", round(sum(oi.price * oi.quantity)::numeric, 2) AS "Сумма" FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(o.status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled') GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT title AS "Товар", stock AS "Остаток" FROM products WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(status::text) = 'active' AND stock <= 5 ORDER BY stock ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT count(*) AS "Доставлено", round(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - shipped_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS "Среднее, ч", round(min(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - shipped_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS "Минимум, ч", round(max(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - shipped_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS "Максимум, ч" FROM orders WHERE seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(status::text) = 'delivered' AND shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT p.title AS "Товар", p.price AS "Цена", p.stock AS "Остаток", p.created_at AS "Создан" FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND lower(o.status::text) NOT IN ('created','cancelled') WHERE p.seller_id IN (${seller_id}) AND lower(p.status::text) = 'active' AND oi.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 30
